name: a bold claim with one word in colour, over a thumbnail row
looks: A two-line bold claim fades in, with one key word picked out in a bright accent colour mid-sentence. A short row of small preview thumbnails sits beneath it, quiet and secondary to the headline.
build: The headline fades/rises 6-8px in on power2.out, the accent word's colour set from the start rather than swapped; the thumbnail row fades in afterward at lower opacity so it reads as supporting evidence, not competing content.
sound: A soft rise under the headline landing.
prompt: Fade in a bold two-line claim with one key word picked out in a bright accent colour, then bring in a quiet row of small preview thumbnails beneath it that support the claim without competing with it.
